messages.content: 紐約現在的人口是多少？

function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: 截至 2023 年底，紐約市（New York City）的估計人口約為 **860 萬人**。這個數字來自美國人口普查局（U.S. Census Bureau）最新的年度估算，顯示該市在過去十年中保持了穩定增長，並且已經超過了 800 萬人的門檻。
message.reasoning: User asks: "紐約現在的人口是多少？" which means "What is the current population of New York?" They want the population of New York. We need to provide an answer. There's no mention of time conversion. So we just respond with the population. According to latest estimates, New York City population ~8.5 million. But maybe they want the population of New York state? The question says "紐約現在的人口是多少？" Could refer to New York city or state. Usually "紐約" refers to New York City. Provide approximate figure. Use recent estimate: 8.6 million as of 2023. Provide source.
